protocol.cpuThrottling: Set and verify 4x in Chrome DevTools; this page cannot attest the browser setting.
protocol.endpoint: Second requestAnimationFrame after synchronous Canvas draw and text commit; paint proxy, correlate with trace frames/screenshots.
protocol.commandTiming: Scripted range/inspection command start; excludes physical device/input dispatch latency.
protocol.memory: No tab-memory estimate is made. Record browser Task Manager footprint and worker attribution separately.
protocol.timeoutLimit: A watchdog cannot preempt a blocked main thread or guarantee recovery from an out-of-memory crash.
protocol.coldLoad: Only autorun query loads report navigation-to-paint proxy. Disable cache and use independent reloads for cold samples.

hoverProtocol.input: Trusted DOM mousemove timestamp, one requestAnimationFrame before the same renderer coordinate mapping and source inspection
hoverProtocol.endpoint: React inspector DOM commit, then double-animation-frame paint proxy; correlate with trace Paint
hoverProtocol.mode: Discrete pointer moves while armed; busy moves are counted and ignored, not a continuous-sweep benchmark
